title: Predicting build orientation for SLM dental parts: a comparison of rotation representations and direct vector regression
abstract: arXiv:2609.15710v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Build orientation for selective laser melting (SLM) manufacturing of dental parts is usually chosen manually by technicians. We treat orientation prediction as supervised machine learning of the part's up-axis from technician-labeled production data, and test which rotation representations produce the best results. Using $n\approx2400$ patient-specific dental parts, we trained a ResNet-50 multi-view image backbone and a PointNeXt-S point-cloud backbone, both pretrained and fine-tuned end-to-end, on 13 up-axis representations spanning six classical $SO(3)$ parameterizations and seven representations defined directly on the unit sphere $S^2$. We report the geodesic angular error between predicted and ground-truth up-axis on a test set, with and without test-time augmentation (TTA) over $K=21$ known rotations. translated_title: 预测SLM牙科零件的构建方向：旋转表示与直接矢量回归的比较
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.15710v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：在选择性激光熔化（SLM）牙科零件制造中，构建方向通常由技术人员手动选择。我们将方向预测视为一个监督机器学习任务，即从技术人员标注的生产数据中学习零件的上轴方向，并测试哪些旋转表示能产生最佳结果。使用约2400个患者定制牙科零件，我们训练了ResNet-50多视图图像骨干网络和PointNeXt-S点云骨干网络，两者均经过预训练并进行端到端微调，测试了13种上轴表示方法，涵盖六种经典SO(3)参数化和七种直接定义在单位球面S²上的表示。我们在测试集上报告了预测上轴与真实上轴之间的测地角误差，分别在K=21个已知旋转上使用和不使用测试时增强（TTA）两种情况进行评估。使用TTA时，八面体映射取得了最低的平均角误差（10.6°，ResNet-50）。整体误差最低的三个结果……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该研究将SLM牙科零件的构建方向预测转化为基于约2400个标注生产数据的监督学习问题，系统比较了13种旋转表示方法，发现使用测试时增强时，八面体映射表示在ResNet-50骨干网络上取得了最低的平均角误差（10.6°）。
en_tdlr: This study formulates build orientation prediction for SLM dental parts as supervised learning from ~2400 technician-labeled production samples, systematically comparing 13 rotation representations, and shows that with test-time augmentation the octahedral map achieves the lowest mean angular error (10.6°) on a ResNet-50 backbone.
